$comment: What of this repository is published to the public editor repository, and what
is not. Read scripts/ci/public-tree.mjs and docs/REPO_TRUTH.md before editing.
A path is published unless `internal` claims it. `public_only` names the files
that exist only on the public side -- its own CI guards and its own README
material -- so a publication carries them forward instead of deleting them.
Every entry carries the reason it is here. An entry without one is a path
somebody hid, and the difference between hiding and publishing is the whole

Signs and publishes builds. A workflow file is editable in a pull request, so a secret it can reach is a secret that has left the building.
